description: An agent-based, network-embedded social diffusion and market-supply simulation of mask adoption under social influence, policies, media campaigns, and retail constraints. Individuals decide to wear masks based on social signals, risk perceptions, policy enforcement, costs, and household norms, while retailers set prices and manage inventories under demand and restocking processes.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs and maintains the social contact network (Watts-Strogatz), household links, and workplace bipartite ties.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  G_social = watts_strogatz(n=population_size, k=avg_degree, p=rewiring_prob)
  assign households by sampling sizes ~ Poisson(household_size_lambda) until all persons assigned
  create household edges fully-connected within households (optional attribute weights)
  assign workplaces to workplace_coverage_rate * persons into workplaces of mean size workplace_size_mean
  construct bipartite edges person<->workplace
  output graphs
notes: Runs only on day 0 to initialize networks.
Edges store last_observed_mask state timestamps to support observation_window_days.

modules.name: InitializationModule
modules.description: Initializes agent attributes, retailers, locations, and seeds initial adoption and inventories.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  set RNG seed
  sample income_level per person using income_share_* proportions
  sample age ~ N(age_mean, age_std) clipped [0, 100]
  sample risk_perception ~ N(risk_perception_base_mean, risk_perception_base_std) clipped [0,1]
  sample attitude_toward_masks ~ N(attitude_base_mean, attitude_base_std)
  sample trust_in_authorities ~ N(trust_in_authorities_mean, trust_in_authorities_std) clipped [0,1]
  sample compliance_propensity ~ N(compliance_propensity_mean, compliance_propensity_std) clipped [0,1]
  set mask_inventory = initial_mask_inventory_per_person
  set adoption_state = Bernoulli(initial_adoption_rate)
  create Retailer agents with initial_retailer_inventory and price ~ LogNormal fitted from mask_price_mean, mask_price_std
  create Location agents for each type with enforcement_level ~ N(location_enforcement_mean, location_enforcement_std) clipped [0,1] and capacity means by type
notes: Clipping ensures probabilities in [0,1].
Retailer prices initialize with positive support using lognormal fit.

modules.name: InformationCampaignModule
modules.description: Models media information diffusion affecting risk perception and attitudes via campaign intensity and media message mix.

update_rule.pseudocode:
policy_active = (t >= mandate_start_day) and (t <= mandate_end_day)
media_signal = campaign_intensity * (pro_mask_message_share - anti_mask_message_share * anti_mask_effect_strength)
cred = media_credibility_mean
for each person i:
  epsilon ~ N(0, info_noise_std)
  delta_risk = risk_perception_sensitivity * cred * (media_signal + epsilon) * i.trust_in_authorities
  i.risk_perception = clip(i.risk_perception + delta_risk, 0, 1)
  i.attitude_toward_masks = i.attitude_toward_masks*(1 - attitude_decay_rate) + cred*(media_signal + epsilon)
notes: Media effect is modulated by trust and credibility.
Attitudes decay toward neutral without reinforcement.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceModule
modules.description: Updates perceived social norm based on observed neighbors, households, and word-of-mouth exchanges.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  neighbors = social_neighbors(i)
  observed_share = mean(adoption_state of neighbors observed over last observation_window_days)
  household_share = mean(adoption_state of household members excluding i)
  social_signal = social_influence_strength * observed_share + word_of_mouth_strength * household_share
  i.social_influence_weight = clip(social_signal, 0, 1)
  i.attitude_toward_masks += 0.5 * (social_signal - 0.5)
notes: Observation window smooths day-to-day fluctuations.
Attitude nudged toward social norm.

modules.name: MarketModule
modules.description: Handles mask consumption, purchasing decisions, retailer pricing, rationing, and restocking dynamics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each retailer r:
  # Restock with possible lead time smoothing
  r.inventory += restock_rate_per_day * initial_retailer_inventory * exp(-max(0, restock_lead_time_days - 1)/restock_lead_time_days)
  inv_ratio = clip(r.inventory / initial_retailer_inventory, 0, 2)
  r.price = max(0.1, mask_price_mean * (1 + price_elasticity_to_stockout * (1 - inv_ratio)) + Normal(0, mask_price_std/3))
for each person i:
  # Consume masks if wearing
  if i.adoption_state == 1:
    i.mask_inventory = max(0, i.mask_inventory - mask_consumption_per_day_if_wearing)
  # Purchase trigger
  if i.mask_inventory <= min_inventory_threshold_to_purchase:
    desired_qty = min(rationing_limit_per_purchase, max(1, round(purchase_quantity_preference_mean)))
    choose retailer r* with lowest price among non-empty inventories (break ties randomly)
    qty_sold = min(desired_qty, r*.inventory)
    cost = qty_sold * r*.price
    # Perceived cost updated as exponential moving average
    i.perceived_cost = 0.7 * i.perceived_cost + 0.3 * r*.price if i.perceived_cost>0 else r*.price
    r*.inventory -= qty_sold
    i.mask_inventory += qty_sold
    record transaction price r*.price
# Aggregate observables
stockout_count = count(retailers with inventory <= 0)
price_paid_daily = mean(transaction prices today) if any transactions else last_nonmissing_price
notes: Prices respond to inventory scarcity.
Perceived cost tracks experienced prices.
Rationing caps per-visit purchases; income can be used to extend to budget constraints if data available.

modules.name: PolicyModule
modules.description: Activates and deactivates mask mandates and sets fines; exposes policy_active signal.

update_rule.pseudocode:
policy_active = (t >= mandate_start_day) and (t <= mandate_end_day)
output policy_active
set fine_amount signal = fine_amount
notes: Provides a global binary policy signal for other modules.

modules.name: EnforcementModule
modules.description: Applies enforcement at locations; records denials and fines for noncompliant entries when a mandate is active.

notes: Arrival process can be approximated by sampling a fixed number proportional to capacity.
Denial and ticket probabilities can be calibrated to match observed rates.

modules.name: AdoptionDecisionModule
modules.description: Computes daily decision to wear a mask using a logistic choice model combining social, risk, policy, and cost components.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  x = logistic_intercept
  x += social_influence_strength * (i.social_influence_weight - 0.5)
  x += risk_perception_sensitivity * (i.risk_perception - 0.5)
  x += policy_sensitivity * (policy_active * i.trust_in_authorities)
  x += information_weight * i.attitude_toward_masks
  # Cost discourages adoption
  cost_term = cost_sensitivity * perceived_cost_scaler * i.perceived_cost
  x -= cost_term
  # Household norm
  x += household_norm_weight * household_norm(i.household_id)
  p_wear = 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
  i.adoption_state = Bernoulli(p_wear * i.compliance_propensity)
notes: Compliance propensity caps realized behavior.
Centering risk and social inputs around 0.5 keeps intercept interpretable.

modules.name: HouseholdModule
modules.description: Updates household norms and allocates mask supply; may trigger bulk purchases.

notes: Bulk buying reflects within-household coordination.
Norm strength is an EMA of member adoption.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and prepares metric inputs.

notes: Keeps a rolling buffer for last 14 days.
Ensures observables are available for metrics computation.

algorithms.LogisticAdoption: Logistic probability model with social, risk, policy, cost, information, and household norm components; Bernoulli draw with compliance cap.
algorithms.RetailPricing: Scarcity-driven price adjustment: price = base*(1 + elasticity*(1 - inv_ratio)) + noise.
algorithms.Restocking: Continuous inventory replenishment proportional to initial inventory with lead-time dampening.
algorithms.DifferenceInDifferences: Average(post-policy adoption) - Average(pre-policy adoption) controlling with policy_active indicator.
algorithms.GiniAcrossGroups: Gini coefficient computed across group mean adoption rates.
algorithms.RollingWindow: Rolling aggregation for last N days for sustained adoption metric.
